explanation: Let dp[v] count ordered sequences totaling v. For every candidate as the final value, add dp[v-candidate]. This displayed C++ version uses fixed-width uint64_t intermediate cells and returns the promised int-sized count.
timeComplexity: O(target × c) fixed-width arithmetic steps for c candidates.
